title: Tundra: glacier_shellback, icicle_bat, shagtusk, sabrefang still look like generic recolored templates
steps: spawn every __isles.packSpecies below the hero, screenshot
expected: Each species reads as its name (bat, shelled creature, tusked/fanged beast)
actual: Same horned blob / saddled quadruped templates as round 1; icicle bat is still not a bat. creatures().src is now empty for all (was "code"), so the hook no longer shows art source. Matches W-17/W-18 "not landed".

title: Mars: five species still drawn from two shared templates
actual: Unchanged: roly/bubblemoth/dust_devil are one horned blob, rustbeetle/crater_strider one saddled quadruped

title: Frost Dragon and Red Titan still the same recolored bipedal bear body
steps: ?test=1&isle=tundra / mars, bossSpawn, place hero near, wait 1.2 s
expected: Dragon looks like a dragon, titan a colossus
actual: boss().src is "code" for both (arenaSrc "code"); no wings/dragon traits. Same sprite as round 1.

title: Weary boss killed by continued fire
steps: bossHit(14) every 0.25 s sim for 6 s (held fire)
expected: Boss survives held fire so Feed still possible
actual: Boss stayed weary at 1 HP for the whole 6 s of held fire (260 -> 1, never dead); feedable true; bossFeed started taming (st taming, need 7). G-22 grace works. Note: one bossFeed right after bossHit with the hero ~108 px away returned why:none, then worked after a 3 s step (radius / drift, not a confirmed bug).

title: Open isles empty at start
steps: creatures().length at start, then walk 4 legs x 3 x 2.5 s sim
expected: Some creatures near the hero at the start
actual: Start counts: meadow 0, jungle 0, tundra 2 (same as round 1). While walking, counts reached meadow 17, jungle 21, tundra 14 (round 1: 1 in view), so exploring density is much healthier. Only the empty first screen remains.

title: Start areas read as flat fields
actual: Jungle start is still two flat sand/fern blocks, no props in view.

title: Island name truncated
actual: Hero line wraps to "Wanderer - ranger Lv 1" and the area ("Frostfang Tundra - ice coast", "Verdant Jungle - beach", "Red Waste - canyon heart") shows in full over 2-3 lines; no ellipsis. HUD box is taller but clear of the how-to card.

title: Rocket drawn at the bottom edge under toast and buttons
steps: ?test=1&isle=meadow&at=dock, give rocket_core_drift inputs, craft, travel("mars"), shot 0.7 s in
actual: Rocket rises from the bottom, partly behind the dock hint toast and the Sail/Decor buttons; "Lift-off! Tap to skip." toast overlaps the how-to card.

title: How-to card covers the centre and bosses; toasts stack on it
steps: Open any isle first time at 390x844, wait 3-8 s
expected: Card auto-hides / moves off the play area
actual: Card is still open and covers the middle of the screen and the top of the Red Titan; medal / journal toasts still print over it.

title: Hero turns to its walk direction (extra check)
steps: Desktop 1280x720, hold ArrowRight / Left / Down / Up 0.5 s each, read __isles.heroDraw()
actual: right0, right0L (flipped), down0, up1: correct each time. (A step()-driven check showed right0 only because step() without render() does not refresh heroDraw; real key input is correct.)
